_template_notes: lane-signals.json — Per-dimension signal output. Schema: signal-v2. 1 file = 1 scan_type (static-scan, runtime, or llm-scan). Written by lane agent probes. STRIP _template_notes/_schema_notes before writing.
_schema_notes: signal required fields: id, dimension_id, probe_id, severity, fixability, title, location.file, fingerprint, detected_at. severity ∈ {critical,high,medium,low,info}. fixability ∈ {auto_fix,agent_fix,escalate,skip}.
